doc: LlamaForCausalLM (Llama 1-3.x, TinyLlama, Vicuna, Yi, SmolLM 1/2, CodeLlama, ...): the standard decoder as it stands. Written down so a Llama configuration is a Level B read with a named adapter; the same configuration is read identically with no adapter (Level A). A positional limit under another name (max_seq_len, max_sequence_length, n_ctx, seq_length) is not read (the class declares its context); rope_interleaved and sliding_window are accepted only absent/false/null.

$forbid: transformers' LlamaAttention rotates halves (rotate_half), never interleaved pairs
LlamaAttention attends to the whole history
